description: Trigger a job when a Fivetran connector sync completes.

api_key_env_var.label: Api Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var containing the Fivetran API key. Required unless resource_key is set.

api_secret_env_var.label: Api Secret Env Var
api_secret_env_var.description: Env var containing the Fivetran API secret. Required unless resource_key is set.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Job to trigger when sync completes

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional resource key registered by a FivetranResourceComponent. When set, polls run via that resource's own get_client().get_connector_details(...) method instead of the inline api_key_env_var/api_secret_env_var above.

name: Fivetran Sync Sensor
